{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(WIDTH);

    wire op_add = (Oper == 3'b000);
    wire op_ab  = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire op_ba  = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire op_or  = (Oper == 3'b011);
    wire op_and = (Oper == 3'b100);
    wire op_xor = (Oper == 3'b101);
    wire op_xnr = (Oper == 3'b110);
    wire arithmetic_enable = op_add | op_ab | op_ba;
    wire subtract_mode = op_ab | op_ba;

    wire [WIDTH-1:0] x = a ^ b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] adjusted_b = b ^ {WIDTH{subtract_mode}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_p = x ^ {WIDTH{subtract_mode}};
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_g = a & adjusted_b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] prefix_p [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] prefix_g [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] arithmetic_result;

    assign prefix_p[0] = bit_p;

    genvar i, level;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : initial_generate
            if (i == 0) begin : with_carry_in
                assign prefix_g[0][i] = bit_g[i] | (bit_p[i] & op_ab);
            end else begin : without_carry_in
                assign prefix_g[0][i] = bit_g[i];
            end
        end
        for (level = 0; level < LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin : prefix_level
            for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : prefix_bit
                if (i >= (1 << level)) begin : combine
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][i] =
                        prefix_g[level][i] |
                        (prefix_p[level][i] & prefix_g[level][i-(1 << level)]);
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][i] =
                        prefix_p[level][i] & prefix_p[level][i-(1 << level)];
                end else begin : forward
                    assign prefix_g[level+1][i] = prefix_g[level][i];
                    assign prefix_p[level+1][i] = prefix_p[level][i];
                end
            end
        end
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : result_bit
            if (i == 0) begin : low_bit
                assign arithmetic_result[i] = x[i];
            end else begin : upper_bit
                assign arithmetic_result[i] = x[i] ^ op_ab ^ prefix_g[LEVELS][i-1];
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{arithmetic_enable}} & arithmetic_result)
            | ({WIDTH{op_or}}  & (a | b))
            | ({WIDTH{op_and}} & (a & b))
            | ({WIDTH{op_xor}} & x)
            | ({WIDTH{op_xnr}} & ~x);
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline's approximately 1.96 ns critical paths traverse arithmetic carry logic followed by operation-selection logic. Independently expressed addition and two subtraction operations also create opportunities for duplicated arithmetic and a relatively costly final selection network.",
  "rewrite": "Share one arithmetic carry network across all three arithmetic operations and explicitly implement logarithmic-depth parallel-prefix carry generation. Addition computes a+b. Forward subtraction computes a+~b+1. Reverse subtraction computes ~(a+~b), which equals b-a modulo 2^WIDTH. The reverse-subtraction complement is folded into the final XOR equation. Carry-in is absorbed at bit zero, and the least-significant arithmetic output simplifies to a[0]^b[0]. Logical operations use parallel decoded masks with an all-zero default.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The WIDTH=16 instance has four prefix-combination levels rather than a potentially long mapped carry dependency. Sharing arithmetic also reduces the final arithmetic selection burden. A reduction from the 1.96 ns baseline is expected, but its magnitude and even the final timing improvement require measurement with the specified mapping, STA, and electrical flow; no candidate measurements are available.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "A single shared arithmetic network replaces three separately expressed arithmetic operations. The parallel-prefix structure adds intermediate generate/propagate logic and wiring, partly removed by synthesis when unused. This is intended to provide area headroom under the 3074.698880 um2 cap, but mapped area and electrical compliance have not been measured. Operation-decode fanout may require buffering.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, default WIDTH=64, unsigned port widths, combinational behavior, and WIDTH-bit modular truncation. Supports positive WIDTH values, including WIDTH=1 and non-power-of-two widths. For every binary input, Oper values 000 through 110 retain their original operations, and 111 produces zero. There is no state, latency, latch, memory, clock, reset, helper-module dependency, assumption, assertion, or undefined output."
}
